item.title: Episode 1: Welcome In - Four Terminal Agents and a Spend Cap
item.itunes:author: Anmol
item.description:
The first episode of AI Workflow and Tips Daily. Why this show exists (short version: I spent years saving brilliant AI workflow posts I never had time to implement, and feeling behind because of it), then three finds from right across the ecosystem, a recipe that costs nothing, two tips, and one thing to do today that might save you real money.
## In this episode
- **Fresh Finds** — SpaceXAI open-sourced **Grok Build**, its Rust terminal coding agent (Apache 2.0, and honest about what it costs to run); **Clawk**, which boots your agent into a throwaway Linux microVM with a default-deny network; and **i-have-adhd**, the skill file that makes any of eleven agent harnesses lead with the answer instead of the preamble. - **The Recipe** — **OpenWiki** from the LangChain team: repo documentation that generates itself, refreshes on a cron, and opens a pull request. Free if you point it at a local model. - **Two Quick Tips** — Google deprecated `temperature`, `top_p` and `top_k` starting with Gemini 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite, so audit your call sites; and write one `AGENTS.md` instead of eleven tool-specific config files. - **Do This Today** — set a *hard* monthly spend cap on your LLM API account, not just an alert.
Notes on cost, because this show always says so out loud: **Grok Build's binary is free but running it is not** — it needs a browser login or an API key. **Claude Code** requires a paid Claude plan or API billing; there is no free tier. **Clawk, i-have-adhd and OpenWiki are all free and open source**, and OpenWiki runs at zero marginal cost against a local model.
## Sources
- [Grok Build — GitHub](https://github.com/xai-org/grok-build) · [docs](https://docs.x.ai/build/overview) - [Clawk — Show HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48892859) · [repo](https://github.com/clawkwork/clawk) - [i-have-adhd — GitHub](https://github.com/ayghri/i-have-adhd) · [install guide](https://github.com/ayghri/i-have-adhd/blob/main/INSTALL.md) - [OpenWiki — GitHub](https://github.com/langchain-ai/openwiki) · [LangChain announcement](https://www.langchain.com/blog/introducing-openwiki-an-open-source-agent-for-repo-documentation) - [Gemini API changelog](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog) · [scope of the deprecation](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/latest-model) - [AGENTS.md](https://agents.md/) - [OpenAI hard spend limits — changelog](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/changelog) - [Claude Code plan requirements](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup)
## Built by
This show is made by a solo developer who builds things in his spare time. If any of it is useful to you, these are the projects behind it:
- **Handled** — done-for-you content and AI agent workflows for creators and busy professionals. Get in touch: **handled.anmol@gmail.com** - **Culmen Games** — an indie Android game studio. Get in touch: **studiosculmen@gmail.com**
Both are early-stage and built in the open. Questions, ideas, or just want to say hi? Either address above reaches me.
